text: No packer saturation control exists on BH (ALU_ROUNDING_MODE only has stochastic-rounding enables, default off). Lowering every all-ones bf16 mantissa by one ulp before the pack reproduces the host saturation for the group max and moves sub-max datums by <= 1/4 step, so the device stays within one host step.
